title: Two digestion-driven predator kinds on the same prey coexist when equal, and a kind's hunting taxis sets its share: without taxis it keeps 2-4 bodies against 30, at half taxis 13 against 30, at equal taxis 22-23 against 21-24 (two seeds each); a 2x faster or slower digestion barely matters
summary: world2p.py adds to the claim world (20261027T0325-c52-digestion-ecology-claim) a second conserved, self-miscible predator material e that condenses only up its own digestion product q2 and has its own fuel-depletion taxis chiFe; both kinds are added as noise at t=2000 in equal amounts (mb = me = -0.9, half the single-kind amount) and differ only in the listed parameter. Labkit 128^2, t=10000, seeds 0 and 1; mean body counts for t >= 5000 (prey / kind b / kind e): equal kinds 43.7/24.4/22.2 and 42.2/21.4/23.2; chiFe 0.25: 44.4/32.2/13.0 and 43.9/29.8/13.7; chiFe 0: 34.6/32.0/3.7 and 33.9/30.5/1.5; k2e 2x with kde /2: 41/23/26 (end, seed 0); k2e /2, kde 2x: 42/25/22. With equal kinds many prey carry one predator of each kind (competition_rgb.png). The kind without taxis is not removed (its material is conserved) but stays dissolved, and the prey that it would have occupied grow into large free prey and rings.

finding.operator: competition of two conserved digestion-driven predator kinds for one prey population
finding.control: equal-kind run on the same seeds (both kinds chiF 0.5)
finding.result: share of predator bodies of kind e, t>=5000: 0.48/0.52 (equal), 0.29/0.31 (chiFe 0.25), 0.10/0.05 (chiFe 0)

limits: Kinds are fixed (no heredity, no mutation): this is competition between two species, not selection. Each kind has half the single-kind predator material, so persistent tracks per kind are few (0-1 at chiF 0.5, 13 for kind b when e has no taxis). 128^2, two seeds, t=10000. The taxis is c46's written nonreciprocal drift; the trait that wins is the strength of that drift.
